title: Off the Deck
lines: Nick and Josh fish off the deck with Dad.
Josh gets a big fish in his net.
Nick has not got a fish yet.
He tugs and tugs. He gets a shell.
Then his net tugs up a wet sock!
"That is not a fish!" said Nick.
"Sit and hush. Do not let go," said Dad.
Nick sits. He will not tug at all.
Then his net tugs back. Up hops a fish!
"Such a fish!" said Josh. Nick lets it go.

questions.ask: What does Nick pull up before he gets a fish?
questions.listenFor: A shell and a wet sock. Two things - if they name only one, ask "and what else?"

questions.ask: What does Dad tell Nick to do?
questions.listenFor: Sit, hush, and do not let go. It is the line in quote marks - have them find the talking.

questions.ask: What do you think Nick will do the next time he catches a fish?
questions.listenFor: Any guess with a reason. He let this one go in the last line, so that is good evidence to use.
